content: FastAPI OTel instrumentation: use opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi for auto-instrumentation (requests, spans) plus manual custom spans for business logic (retrieval, prompt-construction, generation steps) since auto-instrumentation only covers framework/library calls. Export via OTLP to an OTel Collector (not directly to backend) so the collector can batch/filter/enrich before forwarding to SigNoz. Do not run FastAPI with --reload in the instrumented deployment (breaks instrumentation). Use semantic attributes for indexed fields (service name, deployment version) instead of free text.
